cards.text: Jesus has spent the day teaching a huge crowd by the sea, sitting in a boat (Mark 4:1). When evening comes, He says to His disciples, "Let us cross to the other side."

cards.question: Once the crowd is sent away, the disciples take Jesus with them across the sea. How does Jesus come on board?

answers.text: He joins them at the dock
He wades out to meet them

cards.question: When Jesus and His disciples set out across the sea, other boats are there with Him.

cards.text: Soon a violent windstorm comes up. Not a little breeze, friend. VIOLENT.

cards.question: In the violent windstorm, the waves are breaking over the boat, and it's being ___.

cards.text: That boat is turning into a BATHTUB with oars. And Jesus? He's in the stern, sleeping on the cushion.
Sleeping. On a cushion. Through THAT. When I was stuck in the back of a junk drawer, I jumped every time somebody rattled it looking for tape.

cards.question: With the waves swamping the boat, the disciples let Jesus keep sleeping.
The disciples wake Jesus and call Him Teacher. What do they ask Him?

answers.text: Whether He cares that they're perishing
Whether they should turn back to shore
Whether He can help them row

cards.question: Awake now, Jesus gets up in the swamped boat. He rebukes the ___ and the sea.

cards.text: Then He commands the storm, "Silence!" and "Be still!"

cards.question: Jesus commands the wind and the sea to be silent and still. What happens next?

answers.text: The wind dies down and it's perfectly calm
The waves stop but the wind keeps blowing
The storm slowly fades through the night

cards.text: Then Jesus turns to His disciples with two questions.

cards.question: Jesus has two questions for His disciples. What's the first one?

answers.text: Why did you wake Me up
Why didn't you steer for shore

cards.question: Jesus asks His disciples why they're so afraid. Then He asks them: Do you still have no ___?

cards.text: The sea is flat as a cookie sheet, but the disciples are overwhelmed with fear.

cards.question: Overwhelmed with fear on the calm sea, what do the disciples ask one another?

answers.text: Who is this that even the wind and the sea obey Him
How are we ever going to get back to the shore
Where did such a terrible storm come from so fast
